scientific_integrity: Abe 2026 provides the squared Deegan–Packel formula and an existing concentration measure; Hof et al. provide graphic voting games. The reported result claims only an explicit edge-insertion probability law with lattice discontinuities and a Gaussian critical window. The proof and executable finite checker are supplied. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for simple edge-generated monotone voting games, an independently sampled graph with edge density c/n + beta/n^(3/2), and insertion of one conditioned-absent fixed pair. No conclusion is claimed for correlated coalition formation, arbitrary coalition sizes or other power indices. Finite and numerical evidence does not establish the asymptotic CLT. Published or unindexed equivalent results may exist.
title: The lattice-window law for concentration after adding a decisive pair
